items.title: Add resource-context request alternatives and operation-error models
items.summary: Make the existing resources input optional in the new preview, add optional resourcesWithContext alternatives, and add request/response models used by bulk operation-error workflows. Existing resource-bearing requests remain valid.

inferenceResults.rationale: ExecuteDeleteRequest adds an optional resourcesWithContext alternative while resources only becomes optional in the new preview. Existing requests supplying resources remain valid and no additional breaking candidate is established.
ExecuteDeallocateRequest adds an optional resourcesWithContext alternative. Existing resource-based requests remain valid and no additional incompatibility is established.
ExecuteHibernateRequest adds an optional resourcesWithContext alternative. Existing callers can continue supplying resources.
ExecuteStartRequest adds an optional resourcesWithContext alternative. This is additive for existing request construction.
ExecuteReimageRequest adds an optional resourcesWithContext alternative while preserving the existing resources property for callers. No additional break is established.
